title: Our Services
description: We offer practical and beginner-friendly Bitcoin sessions designed to help individuals and small businesses understand Bitcoin more clearly, avoid common mistakes, and take better next steps.

howToChoose.title: Not sure which session is right for you?
points: If you are completely new to Bitcoin, start with the Bitcoin Intro Session.
If you already want practical guidance around wallets and safer setup, choose Wallet & Security Setup.
If you are a founder or business owner exploring Bitcoin from a company perspective, choose Bitcoin for Small Business.

services.title: Bitcoin Intro Session
services.subheadline: A 60-minute beginner-friendly session for people who want a clear, practical, and no-hype introduction to Bitcoin.
description: Perfect for anyone who is curious about Bitcoin but feels overwhelmed by technical explanations, conflicting opinions, or online noise.
This session is designed to give you a calmer and clearer starting point, so you can understand the fundamentals before taking any next step.
bestFor: People who want to understand Bitcoin before doing anything practical
People who feel confused by the wider crypto space
Anyone looking for a simple and structured introduction
whatWeCover: What Bitcoin is and why it matters
How Bitcoin works at a high level
How Bitcoin differs from the broader crypto space
Practical next steps based on your situation
whatYouLeaveWith: A better sense of what matters and what does not
A practical idea of your next step

services.title: Wallet & Security Setup
services.subheadline: A 90-minute guided session for people who want practical help understanding wallets, backup basics, and safer Bitcoin habits.
description: This session is designed for people who want more than theory and need calm, practical guidance before taking their next step.
We help you understand the basics of wallets and security in a simple way, so you can move forward with better habits and fewer beginner mistakes.
bestFor: People who already own some Bitcoin and want more clarity
People who are unsure about wallets and backup basics
Anyone who wants safer first steps without unnecessary complexity
whatWeCover: Hot wallets and hardware wallet basics
Safer next steps based on your situation
whatYouLeaveWith: A clearer understanding of how wallets work
More confidence in your setup decisions

services.title: Bitcoin for Small Business
services.subheadline: A practical workshop for small businesses that want to understand whether Bitcoin is relevant for them from a clear and business-focused perspective.
description: Designed for founders and business owners who want a no-hype view of Bitcoin and its possible relevance to their business.
This workshop helps you understand where Bitcoin may or may not fit, what practical opportunities and limitations exist, and what a reasonable next step could look like.
bestFor: Businesses exploring Bitcoin as a topic, payment option, or strategic area
Teams that want a clearer internal understanding before making any decisions
whatWeCover: How Bitcoin differs from the broader crypto space
Where Bitcoin may or may not be relevant
Suggested next steps for your business
whatYouLeaveWith: A clearer business perspective on Bitcoin
